```{=html}
<style>
:root {
  --rc2-red:        #A93632;
  --rc2-red-dark:   #6E1F1D;
  --rc2-green:      #626A38;
  --rc2-green-dark: #2E3B24;
  --rc2-green-soft: #D7DDC5;
  --rc2-ochre:      #D99A27;
  --rc2-cream:      #F6F1E8;
  --rc2-paper:      #FFFDF7;
  --rc2-ink:        #171717;
  --rc2-muted:      #675F55;
  --rc2-line:       rgba(98,106,56,0.22);
  --rc2-shadow:     0 16px 34px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);

  --rc2-safe-gutter: clamp(0.75rem, 2.6vw, 2.25rem);
  --rc2-content-max: 1260px;
  --rc2-wide-max:    1480px;
  --rc2-xl-max:      1560px;
}

*, *::before, *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html,
body {
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
  overflow-x: clip !important;
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

body {
  margin: 0 !important;
  background:
    linear-gradient(rgba(246,241,232,0.90), rgba(246,241,232,0.86)),
    url("figures/c2_bg.jpg");
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  background-size: cover;
  background-attachment: fixed;
  background-position: center top;
  color: var(--rc2-ink);
  font-family: 'Montserrat', Arial, sans-serif;
}

img,
video,
iframe,
svg,
canvas {
  max-width: 100%;
}

a {
  color: var(--rc2-red);
}

#quarto-content,
#quarto-document-content,
main,
main.content,
.page-columns,
.page-columns .content {
  min-width: 0 !important;
  max-width: none !important;
  overflow-x: visible !important;
}

#quarto-content,
#quarto-document-content,
main,
main.content,
.page-columns,
.page-columns .content {
  margin-left: 0 !important;
  margin-right: 0 !important;
  padding-left: 0 !important;
  padding-right: 0 !important;
}

main.content {
  background: transparent;
  width: 100% !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}

.quarto-title-block,
#title-block-header {
  display: none !important;
}

/* Navbar */
.navbar {
  box-shadow: 0 2px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.10);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
}

.navbar .navbar-brand,
.navbar .nav-link {
  font-family: 'Montserrat', Arial, sans-serif;
}

.navbar .nav-link.active-section {
  color: var(--rc2-red) !important;
  font-weight: 800;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--rc2-red);
}

/* =========================================================
   HERO · versão limpa
   ========================================================= */
.rc2-home-hero {
  position: relative;
  left: 50%;
  right: 50%;
  width: 100vw !important;
  max-width: 100vw !important;
  min-height: calc(100svh - 88px);
  margin-top: 0 !important;
  margin-bottom: 0 !important;
  margin-left: -50vw !important;
  margin-right: -50vw !important;
  display: grid;
  align-items: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  isolation: isolate;
  background:
    linear-gradient(108deg, rgba(23,23,23,0.54) 0%, rgba(46,59,36,0.38) 48%, rgba(110,31,29,0.25) 100%),
    url("figures/c2_bg.jpg");
  background-size: cover;
  background-position: center center;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  color: #fff;
}

.page-columns .content > .rc2-home-hero,
#quarto-document-content > .rc2-home-hero,
main.content > .rc2-home-hero {
  grid-column: screen-start / screen-end !important;
}


.rc2-home-hero::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    rgba(0,0,0,0.18) 0%,
    rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 48%,
    rgba(0,0,0,0.28) 100%
  );
  pointer-events: none;
}

.rc2-home-hero-inner {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  width: min(1120px, calc(100% - var(--rc2-safe-gutter) * 2));
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: clamp(2rem, 5vh, 4rem) 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-start;
}

.rc2-home-brand {
  max-width: min(900px, 100%);
}

.rc2-home-copy {
  min-width: 0;
}

.rc2-home-title {
  margin: 0;
  color: #fff;
  font-family: 'Montserrat', Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: clamp(4.4rem, 10.5vw, 10rem);
  line-height: 0.88;
  font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: -0.09em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  text-shadow: 0 12px 36px rgba(0,0,0,0.50);
  animation: fadeSlideUp 0.75s 0.08s ease both;
}

.rc2-home-title .line-rede {
  color: var(--rc2-ochre);
}

.rc2-title-rule {
  width: min(270px, 42vw);
  height: 4px;
  margin: clamp(0.85rem, 1.5vw, 1.15rem) 0 clamp(0.85rem, 1.5vw, 1.1rem);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--rc2-ochre), rgba(246,241,232,0.24));
  animation: fadeSlideUp 0.75s 0.16s ease both;
}

.rc2-home-subtitle {
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 820px;
  color: rgba(255,253,247,0.97);
  font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif;
  font-size: clamp(1.32rem, 2.55vw, 2.28rem);
  line-height: 1.16;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.48);
  animation: fadeSlideUp 0.75s 0.24s ease both;
}

/* =========================================================
   SEÇÕES
   ========================================================= */
.rc2-section,
.content-card {
  width: min(var(--rc2-content-max), calc(100% - var(--rc2-safe-gutter) * 2));
  margin: 2.4rem auto 0;
  padding: clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 2.4rem);
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 100% 0%, rgba(217,154,39,0.08), transparent 32%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,253,247,0.96), rgba(246,241,232,0.88));
  border: 1px solid rgba(98,106,56,0.18);
  border-top: 5px solid var(--rc2-green);
  box-shadow: var(--rc2-shadow);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.rc2-section--wide {
  width: min(var(--rc2-wide-max), calc(100% - var(--rc2-safe-gutter) * 2));
}

.rc2-section--xl,
#institutions {
  width: min(var(--rc2-xl-max), calc(100% - var(--rc2-safe-gutter) * 2));
}

.rc2-section-title {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 90px 1fr;
  gap: 0.8rem;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 1.35rem;
}

.rc2-section-title::before {
  content: "";
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--rc2-ink);
  opacity: 0.72;
}

.rc2-section-title h2 {
  margin: 0;
  padding-bottom: 0.45rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(98,106,56,0.18);
  color: var(--rc2-red);
  font-family: 'Montserrat', Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 2.1rem);
  font-weight: 900;
  line-height: 1.05;
  letter-spacing: -0.045em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.rc2-lead,
.lead {
  margin: 0 0 1.25rem 0 !important;
  padding-left: 1rem;
  border-left: 5px solid var(--rc2-ochre);
  color: #191711 !important;
  font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif !important;
  font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 2vw, 1.3rem) !important;
  line-height: 1.65 !important;
}

.rc2-section p,
.content-card p {
  color: var(--rc2-ink);
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  line-height: 1.72;
}

.rc2-pills {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  margin: 1.1rem 0 0;
}

.rc2-pill,
.pill {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  padding: 0.32rem 0.72rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(246,241,232,0.84);
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(98,106,56,0.28);
  color: var(--rc2-green-dark);
  font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 0.66rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.07em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.rc2-pill--red {
  color: var(--rc2-red);
  border-color: rgba(169,54,50,0.32);
  background: rgba(169,54,50,0.08);
}

.rc2-pill--green {
  color: var(--rc2-green-dark);
  border-color: rgba(98,106,56,0.32);
  background: rgba(98,106,56,0.09);
}

.rc2-pill--ochre {
  color: #7A5A18;
  border-color: rgba(217,154,39,0.42);
  background: rgba(217,154,39,0.10);
}

.rc2-grid-2 {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 280px), 1fr));
  gap: 1rem;
}

.rc2-grid-3 {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 260px), 1fr));
  gap: 1rem;
}

.rc2-grid-4 {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 220px), 1fr));
  gap: 0.9rem;
}

.rc2-card,
.proto-card,
.sites-box,
.info-box {
  position: relative;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: rgba(255,253,247,0.84);
  border: 1px solid var(--rc2-line);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 22px rgba(0,0,0,0.065);
  transition: transform 0.18s ease, box-shadow 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease;
}

.rc2-card:hover,
.proto-card:hover,
.sites-box:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  border-color: rgba(169,54,50,0.30);
  box-shadow: 0 14px 26px rgba(0,0,0,0.10);
}

.rc2-card h3,
.proto-card h3,
.sites-box h3 {
  margin: 0 0 0.7rem 0;
  color: var(--rc2-green-dark);
  font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.11em;
  line-height: 1.25;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.rc2-card p,
.proto-card p,
.sites-box p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--rc2-muted);
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* =========================================================
   FEATURE BAND
   ========================================================= */
.rc2-feature-band {
  position: relative;
  width: 100vw;
  max-width: 100vw;
  margin: 2.6rem calc(50% - 50vw) 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  overflow-x: clip;
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(246,241,232,0.96), rgba(246,241,232,0.84)),
    url("figures/c2_bg.jpg");
  background-size: cover;
  background-position: center;
}

@supports not (overflow: clip) {
  .rc2-feature-band {
    overflow: hidden;
  }
}

.rc2-feature-title-wrap {
  width: min(var(--rc2-content-max), calc(100% - var(--rc2-safe-gutter) * 2));
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.5rem) 0 1.15rem;
}

.rc2-feature-title {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0.5rem 1rem 0.5rem 0.72rem;
  background: var(--rc2-green-dark);
  color: var(--rc2-cream);
  border: 1px solid rgba(217,154,39,0.35);
  font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
  line-height: 1;
  font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: -0.05em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.14);
  gap: 0.72rem;
}

.rc2-feature-title-accent {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 18px;
  height: 48px;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    rgba(246,241,232,0.92) 0 3px,
    transparent 3px 6px
  );
  border-left: 4px solid var(--rc2-ochre);
}

.rc2-feature-grid {
  display: grid;
  width: 100%;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
  min-height: clamp(420px, 38vw, 640px);
}

.rc2-feature-photo,
.rc2-feature-panel {
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: clamp(420px, 38vw, 640px);
}

.rc2-feature-photo {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--rc2-green-dark);
}

.rc2-feature-photo img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: center;
  display: block;
  filter: saturate(0.92) contrast(1.06);
  transition: transform 1.15s ease, filter 1.15s ease;
}

.rc2-feature-photo:hover img {
  transform: scale(1.045);
  filter: saturate(1.02) contrast(1.10);
}

.rc2-feature-photo::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.04), rgba(0,0,0,0.22));
  pointer-events: none;
}

.rc2-feature-panel {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding:
    clamp(1.15rem, 2vw, 1.95rem)
    clamp(0.95rem, 1.55vw, 1.35rem)
    clamp(0.9rem, 1.4vw, 1.2rem)
    clamp(0.88rem, 1.45vw, 1.2rem);
  color: #fff;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.rc2-feature-panel > * {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.rc2-feature-panel--sites {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #5F6A38 0%, #52602F 100%);
}

.rc2-feature-panel--gradients {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2E3B24 0%, #26331F 100%);
}

.rc2-feature-panel--products {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #935912 0%, #7B261E 100%);
}

.rc2-feature-panel h3 {
  width: fit-content;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0.42rem 0.86rem;
  background: rgba(110,31,29,0.88);
  color: var(--rc2-cream);
  border-left: 5px solid var(--rc2-ochre);
  font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  line-height: 1.25;
}

.rc2-feature-panel p {
  margin: 0 !important;
  max-width: 13ch;
  color: rgba(255,253,247,0.98) !important;
  font-family: 'Montserrat', Arial, sans-serif !important;
  font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 1.48vw, 1.68rem) !important;
  line-height: 1.10 !important;
  font-weight: 900 !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em !important;
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
  text-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.20);
  overflow-wrap: normal;
  word-break: normal;
  hyphens: none;
}

.rc2-feature-panel-num {
  align-self: flex-end;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
  font-family: 'Montserrat', Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 4.2vw, 4.6rem);
  font-weight: 900;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: -0.08em;
  user-select: none;
}

/* =========================================================
   ANIMAÇÕES
   ========================================================= */
@keyframes fadeSlideUp {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(24px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

.reveal-ready {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(40px);
  transition:
    opacity 0.72s ease,
    transform 0.72s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);
  transition-delay: var(--reveal-delay, 0ms);
  will-change: opacity, transform;
}

.reveal-ready.is-visible {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
}

.rc2-feature-band.reveal-ready {
  transform: translateY(42px);
}

.rc2-feature-band.reveal-ready.is-visible {
  transform: translateY(0);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .reveal-ready,
  .rc2-feature-band.reveal-ready {
    opacity: 1 !important;
    transform: none !important;
    transition: none !important;
  }
}

/* =========================================================
   RESPONSIVO
   ========================================================= */
@media (max-height: 760px) and (min-width: 900px) {
  .rc2-home-hero-inner {
    padding-top: 1.4rem;
    padding-bottom: 1.4rem;
  }

  .rc2-home-title {
    font-size: clamp(3.8rem, 9.4vw, 8.4rem);
  }

  .rc2-home-subtitle {
    font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 2vw, 1.75rem);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 1180px) {
  .rc2-home-brand {
    max-width: min(820px, 100%);
  }

  .rc2-feature-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .rc2-feature-photo,
  .rc2-feature-panel {
    min-height: 360px;
  }

  .rc2-feature-panel {
    padding:
      1.05rem
      0.95rem
      0.9rem
      0.9rem;
  }

  .rc2-feature-panel p {
    font-size: clamp(0.98rem, 2vw, 1.32rem) !important;
    max-width: 13ch;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 980px) {
  .rc2-section-title {
    grid-template-columns: 56px 1fr;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .rc2-home-hero {
    min-height: calc(100svh - 76px);
  }

  .rc2-home-hero-inner {
    align-items: center;
  }

  .rc2-home-title {
    font-size: clamp(3.4rem, 18vw, 6.2rem);
  }

  .rc2-home-subtitle {
    max-width: 20ch;
    font-size: clamp(1.15rem, 5.5vw, 1.65rem);
  }

  .rc2-feature-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .rc2-feature-photo,
  .rc2-feature-panel {
    min-height: 280px;
  }

  .rc2-feature-panel {
    padding: 1.25rem 1rem 1rem 1rem;
  }

  .rc2-feature-panel p {
    max-width: 20ch;
    font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 5.2vw, 1.55rem) !important;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 680px) {
  .rc2-feature-title {
    font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 8vw, 1.85rem);
  }

  .rc2-feature-title-accent {
    height: 38px;
  }

  .rc2-section-title {
    grid-template-columns: 34px 1fr;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 420px) {
  :root {
    --rc2-safe-gutter: 0.65rem;
  }

  .rc2-section,
  .content-card {
    padding: clamp(1rem, 4vw, 1.35rem);
    border-radius: 22px;
  }

  .rc2-home-title {
    font-size: clamp(3.1rem, 17vw, 4.8rem);
  }

  .rc2-home-logo-card {
    width: min(165px, 48vw);
  }
}

/* =========================================================
   INSTITUIÇÕES
   ========================================================= */
.inst-grid pre {
  display: none !important;
}

.inst-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 180px), 1fr));
  gap: clamp(0.65rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
  margin-top: 1rem;
  align-items: stretch;
}

.inst-item {
  min-width: 0;
  max-width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.58rem;
  padding: clamp(0.85rem, 1.2vw, 1.05rem);
  min-height: 122px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: rgba(255,253,247,0.88);
  border: 1px solid rgba(98,106,56,0.18);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: transform 0.18s ease, box-shadow 0.18s ease;
}

.inst-item:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.10);
}

.inst-logo {
  width: 100%;
  height: clamp(56px, 5vw, 76px);
  object-fit: contain;
}

.inst-name {
  font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  line-height: 1.22;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #2E3B24;
  text-align: center;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .inst-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

@media (max-width: 380px) {
  .inst-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

.html-widget,
.leaflet,
.leaflet-container,
iframe {
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
}

/* =========================================================
   OVERVIEW FIRST FOLD · full width, conteúdo no primeiro frame
   ========================================================= */
.rc2-overview-fold {
  position: relative;
  width: 100vw !important;
  max-width: 100vw !important;
  margin-top: 0 !important;
  margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw) !important;
  margin-right: calc(50% - 50vw) !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.page-columns .content > .rc2-overview-fold,
#quarto-document-content > .rc2-overview-fold,
main.content > .rc2-overview-fold {
  grid-column: screen-start / screen-end !important;
}

.rc2-overview-media {
  position: relative;
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
  min-height: clamp(320px, 42svh, 460px);
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  display: grid;
  align-items: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  color: #fff;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 86% 18%, rgba(217,154,39,0.26), transparent 32%),
    linear-gradient(106deg, rgba(23,23,23,0.74) 0%, rgba(46,59,36,0.48) 50%, rgba(110,31,29,0.30) 100%),
    url("figures/c2_bg.jpg");
  background-size: cover !important;
  background-position: center center !important;
  background-repeat: no-repeat !important;
}

.rc2-overview-media::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    rgba(0,0,0,0.14) 0%,
    rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 45%,
    rgba(0,0,0,0.48) 100%
  );
  pointer-events: none;
}

.rc2-overview-media-inner {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  width: min(1260px, calc(100vw - var(--rc2-safe-gutter) * 2));
  max-width: calc(100vw - var(--rc2-safe-gutter) * 2);
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: clamp(2.1rem, 4.2vw, 3.5rem) 0 clamp(5.2rem, 8vw, 6.4rem);
}

.rc2-overview-brand {
  margin: 0;
  color: #fff;
  font-family: 'Montserrat', Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: clamp(3.2rem, 7.4vw, 7.1rem);
  line-height: 0.82;
  font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: -0.10em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  text-shadow: 0 12px 42px rgba(0,0,0,0.56);
}

.rc2-overview-brand .line-rede {
  display: block;
  color: #fff;
}

.rc2-overview-brand .line-c2 {
  display: block;
  margin-left: clamp(1rem, 5vw, 4.5rem);
  color: var(--rc2-ochre);
}

.rc2-overview-title-rule {
  width: min(420px, 52vw);
  height: 5px;
  margin: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.05rem) 0 clamp(0.72rem, 1.25vw, 1rem);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--rc2-ochre) 0%, rgba(217,154,39,0.62) 42%, rgba(255,253,247,0.12) 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.26);
}

.rc2-overview-image-title {
  margin: 0 0 0.42rem;
  color: rgba(255,253,247,0.98);
  font-family: 'Montserrat', Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: clamp(0.96rem, 1.45vw, 1.28rem);
  line-height: 1.1;
  font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: 0.07em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  text-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.48);
}

.rc2-overview-image-subtitle {
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 760px;
  color: rgba(255,253,247,0.95);
  font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif;
  font-size: clamp(0.96rem, 1.45vw, 1.18rem);
  line-height: 1.28;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.50);
}

.rc2-overview-wave {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: -1px;
  z-index: 3;
  width: 100%;
  height: clamp(82px, 10vw, 145px);
  display: block;
  color: rgba(255,253,247,0.96);
  filter: drop-shadow(0 -10px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.10));
}

.rc2-overview-content-wrap {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 4;
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
  margin: -1px 0 0 0 !important;
  padding: clamp(0.38rem, 0.8vw, 0.68rem) 0 clamp(0.75rem, 1.25vw, 1.05rem);
  overflow: visible;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,253,247,0.96), rgba(246,241,232,0.88));
}

.rc2-overview-content {
  width: min(1260px, calc(100vw - var(--rc2-safe-gutter) * 2));
  max-width: calc(100vw - var(--rc2-safe-gutter) * 2);
  margin: 0 auto;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(250px, 0.46fr);
  gap: clamp(0.9rem, 1.8vw, 1.35rem);
  align-items: start;
}

.rc2-overview-main {
  min-width: 0;
}

.rc2-overview-lead {
  margin: 0 0 0.38rem 0 !important;
  padding-left: 1rem;
  border-left: 5px solid var(--rc2-ochre);
  color: #191711 !important;
  font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif !important;
  font-size: clamp(0.88rem, 1.05vw, 0.98rem) !important;
  line-height: 1.27 !important;
}

.rc2-overview-content p {
  color: var(--rc2-ink);
  font-size: clamp(0.76rem, 0.86vw, 0.84rem);
  line-height: 1.28;
  margin: 0 0 0.36rem;
}

.rc2-overview-focus {
  min-width: 0;
  margin-top: clamp(-4rem, -4.2vw, -1.4rem);
  padding-top: 0.5rem;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(98,106,56,0.20);
}

.rc2-overview-focus h3 {
  margin: 0 0 0.36rem 0;
  color: var(--rc2-green-dark);
  font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.11em;
  line-height: 1.25;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.rc2-overview-focus p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--rc2-muted);
  font-size: clamp(0.74rem, 0.84vw, 0.82rem);
  line-height: 1.28;
}

.rc2-overview-focus .rc2-pills {
  display: none !important;
}

/* evita que o bloco seguinte use margem full-bleed acumulada à esquerda */
.rc2-feature-band {
  width: 100vw !important;
  max-width: 100vw !important;
  margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw) !important;
  margin-right: calc(50% - 50vw) !important;
  overflow-x: hidden !important;
}

@media (min-width: 1100px) and (max-height: 850px) {
  .rc2-overview-media {
    min-height: clamp(310px, 39svh, 410px);
  }

  .rc2-overview-media-inner {
    padding-top: clamp(1.8rem, 3vw, 2.6rem);
    padding-bottom: clamp(4.5rem, 7vw, 5.6rem);
  }

  .rc2-overview-brand {
    font-size: clamp(3rem, 6.4vw, 6.1rem);
  }

  .rc2-overview-title-rule {
    margin-top: 0.72rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.62rem;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 980px) {
  .rc2-overview-content {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .rc2-overview-focus {
    margin-top: 0;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .rc2-overview-media {
    min-height: calc(100svh - 76px);
  }

  .rc2-overview-media-inner {
    padding-top: 2.6rem;
    padding-bottom: 6.2rem;
  }

  .rc2-overview-brand {
    font-size: clamp(3.25rem, 17vw, 5.8rem);
    line-height: 0.86;
  }

  .rc2-overview-brand .line-c2 {
    margin-left: clamp(0.8rem, 8vw, 2.4rem);
  }

  .rc2-overview-title-rule {
    width: min(280px, 70vw);
  }

  .rc2-overview-image-title {
    max-width: 19ch;
    font-size: clamp(0.95rem, 4.6vw, 1.25rem);
  }

  .rc2-overview-image-subtitle {
    max-width: 24ch;
    font-size: clamp(1rem, 4.8vw, 1.28rem);
  }

  .rc2-overview-wave {
    height: clamp(92px, 19vw, 135px);
  }

  .rc2-overview-content p {
    font-size: 0.88rem;
    line-height: 1.45;
  }
}


/* =========================================================
   FIX FINAL VISUAL FULL-BLEED
   Usa pseudo-elementos para pintar a imagem em 100vw,
   sem depender do Quarto aceitar o bloco como full-width.
   ========================================================= */
html,
body {
  overflow-x: hidden !important;
}

/* O wrapper pode estar preso na coluna; a pintura do hero sangra para fora */
.rc2-overview-fold {
  overflow: visible !important;
}

/* Remove a imagem do box central e pinta a foto em 100vw via ::after */
.rc2-overview-media {
  position: relative !important;
  overflow: visible !important;
  background: none !important;
  isolation: isolate !important;
}

/* Foto full-bleed real, atravessando as laterais do frame */
.rc2-overview-media::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  left: -100vmax;
  right: -100vmax;
  z-index: 0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 86% 18%, rgba(217,154,39,0.26), transparent 32%),
    linear-gradient(106deg, rgba(23,23,23,0.74) 0%, rgba(46,59,36,0.48) 50%, rgba(110,31,29,0.30) 100%),
    url("figures/c2_bg.jpg");
  background-size: cover;
  background-position: center center;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
}

/* Overlay escuro também sangra para as laterais */
.rc2-overview-media::before {
  left: -100vmax !important;
  right: -100vmax !important;
  top: 0 !important;
  bottom: 0 !important;
  inset: 0 -100vmax 0 -100vmax !important;
  z-index: 1 !important;
}

/* Conteúdo e onda acima da pintura full-bleed */
.rc2-overview-media-inner {
  position: relative !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
}

.rc2-overview-wave {
  left: -100vmax !important;
  right: -100vmax !important;
  width: auto !important;
  min-width: calc(100% + 200vmax) !important;
  z-index: 3 !important;
}

/* O branco sob a onda também precisa ocupar toda a largura visual */
.rc2-overview-content-wrap {
  overflow: visible !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 100vmax rgba(255,253,247,0.96);
  clip-path: inset(0 -100vmax);
}

/* Sobe o foco científico para acompanhar melhor a diagonal */
.rc2-overview-focus {
  margin-top: clamp(-5.2rem, -4.8vw, -1.8rem) !important;
}

/* O bloco seguinte não deve herdar escape lateral */
.rc2-feature-band {
  margin-left: 0 !important;
  margin-right: 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
  overflow-x: hidden !important;
}

@media (max-width: 980px) {
  .rc2-overview-focus {
    margin-top: 0 !important;
  }
}


/* =========================================================
   PATCH · remove faixa acima do hero e corrige scientific focus
   ========================================================= */

/* aproxima o hero do navbar, removendo a faixa clara acima da imagem */
.rc2-overview-fold {
  margin-top: -1.55rem !important;
}

/* garante leitura confortável sem perder o primeiro frame */
.rc2-overview-media {
  min-height: clamp(355px, 44svh, 480px) !important;
}

/* mantém a imagem visualmente cheia logo abaixo do navbar */
.rc2-overview-media-inner {
  padding-top: clamp(2.2rem, 4vw, 3.1rem) !important;
  padding-bottom: clamp(5rem, 7.5vw, 6rem) !important;
}

/* dá mais respiro à transição branca abaixo da onda */
.rc2-overview-content-wrap {
  padding-top: clamp(0.9rem, 1.25vw, 1.15rem) !important;
}

/* evita que o texto do foco científico suba demais e seja cortado */
.rc2-overview-focus {
  margin-top: clamp(-1.6rem, -1.8vw, -0.45rem) !important;
  padding-top: 0.8rem !important;
}

.rc2-overview-focus p {
  line-height: 1.34 !important;
}

/* evita qualquer recorte lateral ou escape do bloco seguinte */
.rc2-feature-band {
  margin-left: 0 !important;
  margin-right: 0 !important;
  transform: none !important;
}

@media (max-width: 980px) {
  .rc2-overview-fold {
    margin-top: -1.1rem !important;
  }

  .rc2-overview-focus {
    margin-top: 0 !important;
    padding-top: 0.35rem !important;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .rc2-overview-fold {
    margin-top: -0.9rem !important;
  }

  .rc2-overview-media {
    min-height: calc(100svh - 68px) !important;
  }
}

</style>
```

```{=html}
<section class="rc2-overview-fold" id="inicio" aria-label="RedeC2 homepage overview">
  <div class="rc2-overview-media" aria-label="RedeC2 image banner">
    <div class="rc2-overview-media-inner">
      <h1 class="rc2-overview-brand">

      <h2 class="rc2-overview-image-title">The RedeC2 network</h2>

        Permanent plots for understanding Caatinga and Cerrado dynamics across Brazil's seasonally dry ecosystems.
      </p>
    </div>

    <svg class="rc2-overview-wave" viewBox="0 0 1440 145" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true">
      <path fill="currentColor" d="M0,118 C170,138 330,110 515,100 C690,90 820,134 985,86 C1160,35 1285,48 1440,8 L1440,145 L0,145 Z"></path>

        </p>

        <p>

        </p>

        <p>

          and human-driven disturbances influence vegetation structure,
          successional pathways and the spatial turnover of species.
        </p>

      <aside class="rc2-overview-focus">
        <h3>Scientific focus</h3>
        <p>
          RedeC2 connects long-term vegetation monitoring, ecological gradients,
          taxonomic knowledge and reproducible workflows to support synthesis
          across Caatinga and Cerrado sites.
        </p>
      </aside>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| results: asis
#| output: asis
#| freeze: false
#| cache: false

if (requireNamespace("yaml", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("htmltools", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("knitr", quietly = TRUE)) {

  logo_dir <- "figures/logo_inst"
  manifest_path <- file.path(logo_dir, "institutions.yml")

  if (file.exists(manifest_path)) {
    inst <- yaml::read_yaml(manifest_path)

    inst <- Filter(
      function(x) {
        is.list(x) &&
          !is.null(x$file) &&
          file.exists(file.path(logo_dir, x$file))
      },
      inst
    )

    get_name <- function(x) {
      if (!is.null(x$name)) x$name else ""
    }

    get_url <- function(x) {
      if (!is.null(x$url) && nzchar(x$url)) x$url else ""
    }

    inst <- inst[order(tolower(vapply(inst, get_name, character(1))))]

    make_tile <- function(x) {
      name <- htmltools::htmlEscape(get_name(x))
      file <- htmltools::htmlEscape(x$file)
      url  <- htmltools::htmlEscape(get_url(x))

      inner <- paste0(
        '<img src="figures/logo_inst/', file, '" class="inst-logo" alt="', name, '" loading="lazy" decoding="async">',
        '<div class="inst-name">', name, '</div>'
      )

      if (nzchar(url)) {
        paste0(
          '<a class="inst-item" href="', url, '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">',
          inner,
          '</a>'
        )
      } else {
        paste0(
          '<div class="inst-item">',
          inner,
          '</div>'
        )
      }
    }

    institutions_html <- paste0(
      '<section class="rc2-section rc2-section--xl" id="institutions">',
      '<div class="rc2-section-title"><h2>Participating institutions</h2></div>',
      '<div class="inst-grid">',
      paste(vapply(inst, make_tile, character(1)), collapse = ""),
      '</div>',
      '</section>'
    )

    knitr::asis_output(institutions_html)
  }
}
```

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

  const revealTargets = document.querySelectorAll(
    ".rc2-section, .content-card, .rc2-feature-band, .team-controls, .team-card"
  );

  revealTargets.forEach((el, index) => {
    el.classList.add("reveal-ready");
    el.style.setProperty("--reveal-delay", `${Math.min(index, 8) * 45}ms`);
  });

  if (
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches ||
    !("IntersectionObserver" in window)
  ) {
    revealTargets.forEach(el => el.classList.add("is-visible"));
  } else {
    const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add("is-visible");
          revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, {
      threshold: 0.10,
      rootMargin: "0px 0px -6% 0px"
    });

    revealTargets.forEach(el => revealObserver.observe(el));
  }

  const sections = document.querySelectorAll("section[id]");
  const navLinks = document.querySelectorAll(".navbar a[href]");

  if (sections.length && "IntersectionObserver" in window) {
    const navObserver = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;

        const id = entry.target.id;

        navLinks.forEach(link => {
          const href = link.getAttribute("href") || "";
          link.classList.toggle("active-section", href.endsWith("#" + id));
        });
      });
    }, {
      rootMargin: "-35% 0px -55% 0px",
      threshold: 0
    });

    sections.forEach(section => navObserver.observe(section));
  }

});
</script>
```
